title: Farewell 2026
description: The Farewell Ceremony celebrated the graduating batch with an evening of heartfelt memories, cultural performances, and moments of appreciation. The event also featured the presentation of mementos to the outgoing students and the prize distribution ceremony for the winners of the APL sports tournaments.

title: Unlocking Potential: A Journey into Future Mechanics
description: An engaging talk by Prof. Danny introducing students to prospective avenues of graduate research and development in computational mechanics.

title: Decoding 234: A Hitchhiker's Guide to Tamil Nadu's Electoral Math
description: An interactive session introduced participants to the fundamentals of election forecasting through the lens of statistical analysis. The event explored concepts such as representative sampling, poll aggregation, and Bayesian inference, demonstrating how data-driven methods are used to predict election outcomes. Attendees also gained practical insights into designing and conducting opinion polls for student elections.

title: Tiny Materials, Giant Missions: From Fighting Cancer to Surviving Space
description: The session explored the transformative role of nanotherapeutics and nanomaterials in advancing modern healthcare. Participants were introduced to cutting-edge applications of nanoparticles, ranging from targeted cancer therapies to innovative treatments for health challenges encountered during space missions. The event highlighted the growing impact of nanotechnology in shaping the future of medicine and biomedical research.

title: Aditya-L1: India's First Solar Mission Launch Field Visit
description: Students of the department undertook a field visit to witness the historic launch of the Aditya-L1 mission, India's first solar observatory mission. The visit provided a unique opportunity to experience a landmark achievement in space science while gaining insights into the nation's advancements in space technology.

title: Chandrayan-3: Launch Field Visit
description: The department organized a field visit to witness the launch of the Chandrayaan-3 mission, marking a significant milestone in India's space exploration journey. The experience offered students a firsthand view of a historic launch while inspiring curiosity and interest in space science, engineering, and technological innovation.

title: Panel Discussion with Professors on Research Opportunities
description: The department hosted a panel discussion featuring faculty members who shared insights into research pathways, higher studies, and postdoctoral opportunities. The interactive session provided students with valuable guidance on academic careers, research prospects, and future opportunities in engineering and applied sciences.

title: Understanding Mental Health, Peer Support and Self-Care - with Mitr
description: An interactive workshop session, organized with Team Mitr, focusing on mental health awareness and suicide prevention, emphasizing the importance of emotional well-being and resilience. Through expert discussions and interactive sessions, participants explored strategies for recognizing challenges, seeking support, and fostering a healthy and supportive community.

title: Fun Fusion: An Interactive Session with the newly admitted B.Tech Batch of 2025
description: The department organized an interactive icebreaker session to warmly welcome the newly admitted undergraduate students. Through engaging activities and team-based games, the event encouraged students to connect with their peers, build friendships, and begin their academic journey in a fun and inclusive environment.

title: Student-Faculty Team Dinner: B.Tech 2025
description: The Student–Faculty Team Dinner provided an informal setting for students and faculty members to interact beyond the classroom. The gathering fostered meaningful conversations, strengthened relationships, and promoted a sense of community within the department.

title: Industrial Visit: Perfint Healthcare
description: The students of B.Tech (iBME, 2025) had visited Perfint Healthcare, a medical robotics company, providing exposure to cutting-edge technologies in healthcare automation.

title: Visit to IITM Research Park
description: The students of B.Tech (CEM, 2025 & 2026) had visited the IITM Research Park, had the chance to watch closely and interact with people working on their ideas.

title: Recent Trends in Artificial Intelligence for Healthcare
description: The seminar discussed the recent trends in artificial intelligence, progression towards agentic AI and emerging direction in Quantum Machine Learning for healthcare data analysis and optimization.

title: Chalk Talk - Lecture #1
description: The first lecture of this year’s Chalk Talk Series featured two Ph.D. scholars who delved into fascinating topics from the world of the micro- and nanoscale.
